invitations_email_format.name: invitations_email_format
invitations_email_format.value: "invitations"."email" is null or ("invitations"."email" = lower("invitations"."email") and instr("invitations"."email", '@') > 1 and length("invitations"."email") <= 320)

user_university_length.name: user_university_length
user_university_length.value: "user"."university_name" is null or length(trim("user"."university_name")) between 1 and 100
